samples.question: This image shows a grey vertical bar with one coloured step-block shape on each side of it. The bar, the small grey squares on the bar, the grey baseline and the white background are fixed decoration: they never indicate the answer. Both shapes are drawn in the same colour, stand on the same baseline, are built from the same five columns of the same width, cover the same total area, and are placed symmetrically about the bar. The only thing that can differ is the left-to-right order of their five column heights. Read that order off each shape and compare the two, using the image itself and not what a mirror normally does. The right-hand shape is 'mirrored' if its column heights run in the reversed order of the left-hand shape's, and 'copied' if they run in the same order. Answer with exactly one word: mirrored or copied.
